Temporal focus:

T2. Forward-looking reporting short-term risks (next few weeks/months) [NO]
T3. Forward-looking reporting long-term risks (next quarters/years) [YES] — deal completion expected by end of 2026

Synopsis:
Shell is acquiring full ownership of Tri Star Energy, a U.S. convenience store and fuel distribution operator, by buying out remaining stakes from The Parman Corporation and Kimbro Oil Company. This adds 320 directly-owned fuel/convenience sites in Tennessee and surrounding states, plus supply agreements covering 552 dealer-owned locations, expanding Shell's existing ~12,000 U.S. retail fuel network. Deal terms undisclosed; closing expected by end of 2026.
